headline: Hosting Thanksgiving on septic?
alt: Carousel cover: Hosting Thanksgiving on septic? Read this before Thursday.

captions.long:
A full house on Thursday is the hardest day of the year on a septic system. The EPA says many septic failures happen during the holiday season.

Most homes in Newtown, Sandy Hook, Southbury and the rest of our area run on a well and septic, so here are five checks before the guests arrive:
1. Turkey grease goes in a can, not down the drain.
2. Space out the dishwasher and laundry.
3. Keep guest cars off the leach field.
4. Only toilet paper gets flushed.
5. Know when your tank was last pumped (EPA: about every 3 to 5 years).

And thank you. Four years and 21 homes closed across Western CT. I'm grateful to every client who trusted me with their move. Happy Thanksgiving.
